summary: 18 units reviewed against the Sanskrit (10.4.1-18, Kangle e-text). 0 errors, 22 minor issues, all with patches; no regrouping suggested. Word splits, sandhi, case/number labels, compound types and the two-line verse 18 check out. All four draft text_flags are confirmed: unit 3 (missing space after nirutkhātiny/grāhiṇy and the stray 'vratatī.-' inside one compound ending in -bhaṅgurā; cf. units 5 and 7 where the e-text does put a space at such junctions), unit 8 nihśarkarā -> niḥśarkarā (the e-text writes visarga as ś before c/ś elsewhere, e.g. kālāś ca), unit 9 daṇṣṭra -> daṃṣṭra, unit 14 'trāsanaṃ.audāryaṃ' -> 'trāsanam audāryaṃ' (two nouns, as in 10.4.15). Confidence labels are honest: units 13-14 (cavalry/elephant functions) rightly low, since several terms (bāhu-utsāra, viśuddhi, mārga-anusāra-vinimaya, samāja-karma, sthāna-gamana-avataraṇa) have disputed senses and the alternatives are recorded in notes. The minor issues are of two kinds: (a) bracketed glosses inside the Hindi, against the glossary rule (units 1, 2, 6-13, 16, 17); supplied objects such as '(शत्रु को)' were left alone; (b) small interpretive additions in the English ('(suitable)', 'nature of each', 'only', '(the enemy's)/(one's own)', 'the way for'). Glossary extended with the Book 10 military terms used here so later chunks of 10.x stay consistent (vyāyāma = exertion in Book 10 differs from the 6.2 sense; recorded).
